items.title_en: Meet Abhishek Anand: How a Bihar-born IITian now plays cricket for Japan
items.title_zh: 认识阿布舍克·阿南德 (Abhishek Anand)：出生于比哈尔邦的 IITian 现在如何为日本打板球
items.summary_en: All-rounder Abhishek Anand, who is also a right-arm medium pacer, began playing softball cricket in Patna. However, academics remained his priority.
items.summary_zh: 全能运动员阿布舍克·阿南德（Abhishek Anand）也是一名右臂中速运动员，他开始在巴特那打垒球板球。然而，学术仍然是他的首要任务。

items.title_en: Ganesh Visarjan in Antarctica: Scientists make snow idol, perform eco-friendly immersion
items.title_zh: 南极洲的 Ganesh Visarjan：科学家制作雪像，进行环保沉浸
items.summary_en: Researchers from the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research came together to shape the snow into an idol of Bappa before carrying out the usual festivities.
items.summary_zh: 来自国家极地和海洋研究中心的研究人员聚集在一起，在进行通常的庆祝活动之前，将雪塑造成巴帕的偶像。

items.title_en: Bittu Tabahi removes 585 kg garbage from Yamuna; CEO reacts: ‘Slap on administration’
items.title_zh: Bittu Tabahi 从亚穆纳清除了 585 公斤垃圾；首席执行官回应：“打击管理”
items.summary_en: Surendra Singh Choudhary shared a video on September 22, showing volunteers picking up plastic, religious offerings, and other waste from the Delhi-NCR stretch of the Yamuna.
items.summary_zh: 苏伦德拉·辛格·乔杜里 (Surendra Singh Choudhary) 于 9 月 22 日分享了一段视频，视频中志愿者们从亚穆纳河德里至国家首都辖区捡拾塑料、宗教祭品和其他废物。

items.title_en: Neeraj Pandey on Maithili Thakur’s Bihar safety remark: ‘Not everyone’s Bihar is the same’
items.title_zh: Neeraj Pandey 谈 Maithili Thakur 的比哈尔邦安全言论：“并非每个人的比哈尔邦都是一样的”
items.summary_en: Pandey’s comments came after an old video of Thakur defending women’s safety in Bihar resurfaced online following the Jamui molestation and moral policing incident.
items.summary_zh: 潘迪发表上述言论之前，贾穆伊性骚扰和道德警务事件发生后，塔库尔捍卫比哈尔邦妇女安全的旧视频在网上重新出现。

items.title_en: Earn nothing? Pay nothing: 81-year-old Ahmedabad doctor charges patients based on their monthly income
items.title_zh: 什么都赚不到？无需支付任何费用：81 岁的艾哈迈达巴德医生根据患者的月收入向患者收费
items.summary_en: At his clinic, Dr Nandlal Manseta follows a flexible pricing model. Patients are not asked to submit income certificates or any other documents.
items.summary_zh: 在他的诊所，Nandlal Manseta 医生遵循灵活的定价模式。不要求患者提交收入证明或任何其他文件。

items.title_en: ‘Flying Beast’ Gaurav Taneja’s pet dog Mau reportedly dies, ex-employee alleges neglect
items.title_zh: 据报道，“飞兽”高拉夫·塔内贾 (Gaurav Taneja) 的宠物狗毛 (Mau) 死亡，前雇员指控疏忽
items.summary_en: Fitness creator Pushpendra Choudhary shared multiple posts and Stories making allegations about Mau’s health
items.summary_zh: 健身创始人 Pushpendra Choudhary 分享了多篇帖子和故事，对 Mau 的健康提出指控
